source_text: Physical effects of female genital mutilation/cutting (FGM/C) in The Gambia include immediate complications such as hemorrhage, acute anemia, and infections like tetanus, cystitis, and septicaemia, reported in 12.6% of cases seeking prompt medical attention after the procedure. [12]
